Beyond the dancefloor, you’ll discover play areas, chill-out spaces, and a community built on openness, respect, and mutual appreciation. No pressure, no expectations, just a space where you can truly be yourself.

Trance Baby Trance is for everyone seeking freedom, connection, and pure euphoria. A colorful playground where rave culture, community, and Berlin nightlife come together.

▣▣▣ LINE-UP ▣▣▣

Our DJs will take you on a journey through the most exciting sounds of the modern trance movement. Expect euphoric melodies, catchy vocals, emotional builds, and fast, high-energy drops.

From Eurodance-inspired trance and nostalgic 90s rave vibes to modern high-energy club sounds, every artist brings their own unique twist, creating moments made for singing along, throwing your hands in the air, and completely losing yourself on the dancefloor.

The sound: Modern Trance, Eurodance Trance, Rave Revival & High-Energy Club Cuts.

▣▣▣ DRESSCODE ▣▣▣

This is your moment to shine! We want sexy and colorful in all its glorious forms — think vibrant latex, neon harnesses, sheer bodysuits, sparkling lingerie, glitter, mesh, and creative fetish flair. Show us your most playful, radiant, and sexy self while keeping our space respectful and electrifying.

▣▣▣ INSIDE THE CLUB ▣▣▣

▣ No Phones: Entire club is phone-free, leave them at the cloakroom.
▣ No Photos without permission: A photo corner is open 10:30–01:00. Afterwards, a photographer roams until 02:30 (only with permission).
▣ Comfort & Amenities
▣ Showers & Towels: Free of charge, both behind Main dace floor and in the Dungeon.
▣ Refreshments Station: At the bar you’ll find candy, chocolate, fruits and small snacks, plus additional spots throughout the club. Everything is included in your ticket and available all night long.

▣ Couples Area: Overlooks the main dance floor with space to play. Only couples (or couples +1) allowed.
▣ Chill Areas: Smoking lounge, quiet corners, and free earplugs available at multiple spots around the club.
▣ Consent & Awareness: Trained team ensures safer partying. No means no. Ask before touching. Respect boundaries. 

▣▣▣ RULES ▣▣▣

▣ Diversity over prejudice: We celebrate your vibe, not your background. Trance Baby Trance is an inclusive space. Any form of racism, homophobia, transphobia or hate will get you shown the door.
▣ Consent: No means no. Maybe means no. Only a clear “Yes!” means yes and you can change your mind at any time. Consent must be mutual and ongoing.
▣ Clear communication: Speak up, ask first, and listen actively. Verbal or non‐verbal cues count, but always double‐check that everyone’s on board before you dive in.
▣ Respect boundaries: Everyone has personal limits. Always ask, honor every stop signal, and never push beyond what’s been agreed.
▣ Look out & speak up: If you see something off or feel unsafe, reach out to our Awareness Team right away. Together we keep our space free and fun.

▣▣▣ TICKETS & ENTRY ▣▣▣

▣ Having a ticket gives you access to priority queue. There will be tickets sold at the door also.

▣ Student & Social Ticket at the Door (20€): Present valid proof (e.g., student ID, BVG social ticket) for a discounted door ticket.

▣▣▣ DOOR POLICY ▣▣▣

▣ Ticket ≠ Guaranteed Entry: Effort counts, but if your outfit or attitude clashes with the vibe, you may be turned away.
▣ Refunds: If you’re denied at the door after buying a ticket, you get a refund. No-shows aren’t refunded.

▣▣▣ FINAL TIPS ▣▣▣

▣ Arrive Early: Less queue, more time for potential outfit tweaks, and better odds at the door.
▣ Stay Open-Minded: Embrace the vibe, the music, and each other with curiosity.
▣ Ask for Help: If you feel uncomfortable at any point, speak to staff or someone from the awareness team.

▣▣▣ Join us for Trance Baby Trance(Supported by UNDR)! ▣▣▣
